experiment_1_fixed_entry.description: Frozen entry population from Stage 4 held constant. Stops 4/5/6/8/10/12 compared with identical entries. See stage7_fixed_stop_summary.json. Isolates stop-distance effect from occupancy effects.

experiment_2_full_strategy_occupancy.reason: Full strategy drive with real production re-entry rules requires the orchestrator → central gate → trade_manager monitor loop integration (Phase 5 Stage K2 follow-on). The Phase 5 brief explicitly deferred that integration and the Phase 6 brief forbids substituting an unrestricted retry model.
experiment_2_full_strategy_occupancy.production_rule_summary: Standalone BB Bounce (/opt/bb_bounce/strategy.py A10) enforces one open trade per direction; a confirm-while-same-direction-open is CANCELLED. Opposite-direction may arm/wait freely; opening opposite closes the previous trade.
experiment_2_full_strategy_occupancy.implication_for_stop_study: A tighter stop closes losers sooner, freeing the direction slot for another arm earlier. In a *production* run that could materially change the subsequent-trade pool. We cannot quantify that effect in Phase 6 without the full loop; we therefore report Experiment 2 as NOT_EVALUATED and never claim equivalence between Experiment-1 pips and realistic live pips.
experiment_2_full_strategy_occupancy.next_step_authorised_by_operator: If operator wants Experiment 2, request the Phase 5 Stage K2 package: wire trade_manager_adapter + decision event bus into a tick-driven drive loop with real occupancy tracking. Estimated multi-session scope.
